Insurance we accept

We work with Medicare, Maryland Medicaid plans and most major insurers. Plans change often, so please call to confirm yours before your visit.

Medicare

  • Original Medicare
  • AARP Medicare plans
  • Humana Medicare
  • UnitedHealthcare Medicare
  • CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield Medicare

Medicaid and Maryland plans

  • Maryland Medicaid
  • Maryland Physicians Care
  • MedStar Family Choice
  • AmeriGroup
  • UnitedHealthcare Community Plan
  • Jai Medical Systems
  • University of Maryland Health Partners

Commercial and employer plans

  • CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield, including the Federal Employee Program
  • Aetna
  • Cigna
  • UnitedHealthcare
  • Humana
  • Kaiser Permanente
  • GEHA
  • Johns Hopkins Employer Health Programs
  • Meritain Health

Don't see your plan? Call (301) 540-1332. Our front desk can check your coverage before you book.

What to bring to your visit

  • Photo ID
  • All insurance cards, including Medicare and any supplement
  • A list of your medications and doses
  • Recent test results or records from other doctors, if you have them
  • Questions you want to ask, written down
  • A family member, if you'd like help remembering what was said

Ready to see Dr. Ajmal?

New and returning patients welcome. We'll call you back to confirm a time.
